items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I don't know therewasa girl down the street that played piano, Dorothy Green... So then, in my last year in high school this Dorothy Green down the street and another girl were going to Chicago to try out for Chataqua

ctx.x: Then after -- I don't know therewasa girl down the street that played piano, Dorothy Green, who played very good, she was a very talented little girl. And she read and did very well, she used to play in the school and everything, so a couple of years later, I think I was junior in high school, she'd run over to a town called Jacksonville, to take some advanced lessons. There was a school over there --
